reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically questionable because copper has negligible solubility in tungsten and will not form coherent nanoprecipitates; it would likely segregate to grain boundaries, causing embrittlement and degrading both thermal and mechanical properties.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific quantitative falsification criteria, though the impracticality of forming coherent Cu nanoprecipitates in a W-based matrix makes the test moot.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of W-Cu immiscibility, and pursuing it would waste resources on a metallurgically unsound approach.
